title: Use a pop-up button to present a flat list of mutually exclusive options or states

statement.en: Use a pop-up button for a flat list of mutually exclusive options or states.
statement.ja: mutually exclusiveなoptionまたはstateのflat listにはpop-up buttonを使う。

conditions: The selection affects the content or surrounding view.
Use the separate pull-down-button rules when actions, multiple selection, or a submenu are needed.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Pop-up buttons experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるPop-up buttonsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Provide a useful default selection

statement.en: Provide a useful default selection for a pop-up button.
statement.ja: pop-up buttonに有用なdefault selectionを用意する。

conditions: Before people choose, the button displays the default item.
When possible, choose a default that most people are likely to want.
After selection, the button can identify the current choice.
